marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Leading US technology conglomerates announced expanded capital expenditure plans targeting data center expansion and advanced AI chips for the upcoming quarters.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained high capex bolsters semiconductor equipment and hardware supplier revenues, but could compress short-term operating margins for cloud providers until commercial AI software monetization accelerates.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of enterprise software AI revenue conversion relative to ongoing elevated infrastructure depreciation costs.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech Sector & Domestic Cloud Pricing Pressure
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed tech leaders reported steady cloud revenue growth alongside aggressive price reductions on mainstream LLM API services to expand market share.
marketLayer.inference: Price competition accelerates mass-market enterprise adoption across domestic industries, though it compresses gross margins for hyperscalers in the short to medium term.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Ability of value-added enterprise AI solutions to offset margin compression from commoditized base model access.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: U.S. macroeconomic indicators demonstrated modest inflation deceleration, stabilizing Treasury yields and supporting foreign capital inflows into Asian equity benchmarks.
marketLayer.inference: A predictable or easing rate environment reduces risk-free rate drag on high-duration growth equities in both Wall Street and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential sticky core inflation prints or labor market resilience that could alter Fed monetary policy trajectories.

marketLayer.title: Southbound Capital & HK Dividend Stocks
marketLayer.fact: Southbound Stock Connect recorded net capital inflows, primarily targeting high-dividend state-owned energy, telecommunications, and financial counters listed in Hong Kong.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland institutional investors continue leveraging HK-listed dividend plays as a defensive cash-flow yield allocation strategy amid domestic yield declines.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Shift in mainland investor risk appetite toward high-beta tech plays if macroeconomic stimulus measures exceed expectations.
